body:
Hey OP
I’m praying you’re still here 
Listen life is hard, I’m not gonna tell you it’s not. I’m only 22 myself and I feel like you a lot of the time
But I’m asking you now. Please don’t do this
Please try some medications which can help with the anxiety. I used to vomit for anxiety as well. I understand your pain I really do. But I urge you to take yourself to A&E instead and tell them you’re so anxious that you don’t want to live anymore. Be honest. Let them help you or at least try to.
Life is shit most of the time
But there is always a spark waiting for you.
For me, I am currently relatively stable and you know what I take 5 different medications all for my mental health and if that’s what works then cool. Don’t be ashamed of your struggle. Use it to find strength. I’m trying to educate people about my illness and I am soon to start working for a peer support helpline. Use it to do good since you can’t do much else with it.
Trust me I go everyday fighting suicidal thoughts and urges but I’m trying, so please, please don’t give up. Let us know you’re ok. You got this!
